articles.title: Support of Kiev by Europe and US direct participation in war against Russia — Kremlin
articles.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated that weapons supplies, military advisers, and satellite intelligence provided by European countries and the United States to Kiev constitute direct participation in the war with Russia.

articles.title: Putin calls support for domestic exporters priority for Russia
articles.summary: President Putin stated that supporting Russian manufacturers and exporters is a priority for the economy during a meeting with the Russian Export Centre director.

articles.title: Putin notes formation of partnerships by Russian Export Center with friendly states
articles.summary: Putin acknowledged that the Russian Export Center is successfully establishing sustainable partnerships with friendly countries to increase exports by two-thirds by 2030.

articles.title: Kremlin spokesman comments on Putin-Trump call, Russia-China drills
articles.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov addressed the telephone conversation between Putin and Trump, noting Russia maintains contacts with the US through existing channels.

articles.title: IN BRIEF: Putin comments on Russia's strategic goals, security, Duma election
articles.summary: Putin pledged that all strategically important development programs will be implemented in full and confirmed that State Duma elections will be held in September as scheduled.
